module reg_if_07 (
  input clk,
  input rst_n,
  input [7:0] in_data,
  output [7:0] out_data
);

  reg [7:0] reg_file [0:15]; // 16 register entries, each 8 bits
  reg [3:0] addr_reg;        // Address register (4-bit for 16 registers)
  reg write_enable;
  reg read_enable;
  reg [7:0] data_out;

  // Sequential logic for address and control signals
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      addr_reg <= 4'd0;
      write_enable <= 1'b0;
      read_enable <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
      // Accept only aligned addresses (multiple of 2)
      if (in_data[0] == 1'b0) begin
        addr_reg <= in_data[3:0];
        write_enable <= in_data[7];
        read_enable <= ~in_data[7];
      end
    end
  end

  // Combinational logic for register access
  always @(*) begin
    data_out = 8'd0;
    
    if (read_enable) begin
      data_out = reg_file[addr_reg];
    end
  end

  // Register write operation
  always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
      reg_file <= '{default: 8'd0};
    end else if (write_enable && addr_reg[0] == 1'b0) begin // Only aligned writes
      reg_file[addr_reg] <= in_data;
    end
  end

  assign out_data = data_out;

endmodule
